description: Hand-verified capability inventory for Loop Habit Tracker (org.isoron.uhabits), version 2.3.1.

features.name: Create a yes/no habit
features.description: Create a yes/no habit as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.

features.name: Create a measurable habit
features.description: Create a measurable habit as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: enter the unit (for example km, pages, minutes)
choose the target type (at least / at most)

features.name: Set a habit frequency
features.description: Set a habit frequency as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: choose Every day, Every X days, X times per week, X times per month, or a custom ratio

features.name: Set a habit reminder
features.description: Set a habit reminder as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: select the days of the week the reminder should fire

features.name: Add notes to a habit
features.description: Add notes to a habit as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.

features.name: Check off a habit for today
features.description: Check off a habit for today as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: tap the checkmark square in today's column on the habit row; tap again to cycle the state (unchecked, checked, skipped depending on the settings)

features.name: Enter a value for a measurable habit
features.description: Enter a value for a measurable habit as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: tap today's cell on the measurable habit row
type the value in the dialog

features.name: Check off a habit for an earlier day
features.description: Check off a habit for an earlier day as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: scroll the date columns horizontally to the past date
tap the cell for that date, or open the habit detail

features.name: Mark a day as skipped
features.description: Mark a day as skipped as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: Long-press (or repeatedly tap, depending on the settings) the day cell
choose the skip state; skipped days do not break the streak

features.name: Add a note to a specific day's entry
features.description: Add a note to a specific day's entry as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: enter the note text in the dialog

features.name: View a habit's detailed statistics
features.description: View a habit's detailed statistics as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: the detail screen opens showing the overview, the score chart, the history calendar, the streaks list and the frequency (best-time) chart

features.name: View the score/strength chart
features.description: View the score/strength chart as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: tap the interval control to switch between day, week, month, quarter and year granularity

features.name: View the history calendar
features.description: View the history calendar as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: scroll horizontally to move through past months
tap a day to toggle or edit it

features.name: View the streaks chart
features.description: View the streaks chart as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: review the longest and most recent streaks with their date ranges

features.name: View the frequency (weekday/time) chart
features.description: View the frequency (weekday/time) chart as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: review which weekdays the habit is most often completed on

features.name: Edit a habit
features.description: Edit a habit as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: tap the edit (pencil) icon (or long-press the habit in the list and tap Edit)
change the name, question, colour, unit, target, frequency or reminder

features.name: Archive a habit
features.description: Archive a habit as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: tap the archive icon in the contextual toolbar; the habit is hidden from the main list but its data is kept

features.name: Unarchive a habit
features.description: Unarchive a habit as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.

features.name: Delete a habit
features.description: Delete a habit as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: confirm; the habit and all its records are removed

features.name: Reorder habits manually
features.description: Reorder habits manually as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: set the sort order to manual
drag it to the new position

features.name: Sort the habit list
features.description: Sort the habit list as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: choose the criterion (manual, by name, by colour, by score or by status)

features.name: Filter the habit list
features.description: Filter the habit list as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: toggle whether archived habits and completed habits are shown

features.name: Change the number of days shown in the list
features.description: Change the number of days shown in the list as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: Rotate the device or resize the window; Loop adjusts the number of visible day columns. The display can also be adjusted from the appearance settings

features.name: Snooze or dismiss a habit reminder
features.description: Snooze or dismiss a habit reminder as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: tap the check action to record the habit, or tap "Later"/snooze and choose the delay

features.name: Enable persistent (sticky) reminder notifications
features.description: Enable persistent (sticky) reminder notifications as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: toggle it on so reminders remain in the notification shade until acted upon

features.name: Add a habit widget to the home screen
features.description: Add a habit widget to the home screen as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: Long-press an empty area of the Android home screen
drag the required widget type (checkmark, history, score, streaks, frequency or target) onto the home screen
select the habit it should show

features.name: Check off a habit directly from a widget
features.description: Check off a habit directly from a widget as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: Tap the checkmark area on the placed home screen widget; the habit is recorded for today without opening the app

features.name: Export habit data as CSV
features.description: Export habit data as CSV as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: confirm; a ZIP of CSV files with the habits and their check-marks is written

features.name: Create a full database backup
features.description: Create a full database backup as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: confirm; a .db file containing the whole database is produced

features.name: Restore a full backup
features.description: Restore a full backup as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: select the previously exported .db backup file
confirm; the existing data is replaced

features.name: Import data from another habit app
features.description: Import data from another habit app as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: select the exported file from the supported app (for example Tickmate, HabitBull, Rewire or a Loop CSV/DB backup)

features.name: Repair the database
features.description: Repair the database as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: confirm; the app rebuilds the cached scores and check-marks

features.name: Change the app theme
features.description: Change the app theme as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: choose the light theme, the dark theme or the pure black (AMOLED) variant

features.name: Set the first day of the week
features.description: Set the first day of the week as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: tap the "First day of the week" entry

features.name: Set the hour the day starts (day offset)
features.description: Set the hour the day starts (day offset) as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: tap the "New day starts at" entry
return; entries recorded before that hour count towards the previous day

features.name: Enable or disable the check-mark reverse order and skip days
features.description: Enable or disable the check-mark reverse order and skip days as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: toggle the options that control whether the newest day appears first and whether the skip state is available when tapping a cell

features.name: Open the help and FAQ
features.description: Open the help and FAQ as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: Open the navigation drawer or Settings

features.name: View the about screen
features.description: View the about screen as documented for Loop Habit Tracker.
actions: read the version number, the source link and the licence. ## **Category: Finance**
